name: @appbana/platform-kernel
description: AppBana Genesis platform kernel — coordinates artifact resolution, session lifecycle, event bus, and effect dispatch across the runtime engines. Phase 1 scope (WS-1.4 Task 1): in-process Governance Registry that stores active-version pointers per (appId, tenantId), `resolveCam(appId, tenantId)` that chains pointer lookup + metadata-registry fetch + content-hash integrity check, and `buildVersionInfo()` for the /version endpoint per ADR-016.
